title: Protein breakfast keeps you full
armature: Protein at breakfast keeps you full longer: it triggers fullness hormones and digests slower than carbs, so add eggs, Greek yogurt or cottage cheese to your toast or cereal.

scenes.title: A breakfast that lasts.
scenes.narration: Did you know that adding protein to your breakfast can help you feel full longer?

scenes.label: the signal
scenes.narration: Protein helps your body release hormones that signal fullness to your brain.
sources: Batterham et al., Cell Metab 2006; Leidy et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2013: protein raises PYY/GLP-1 and lowers hunger

scenes.title: Slow burn.
scenes.narration: And it takes longer to digest than carbohydrates alone.

scenes.label: — the swap
scenes.title: Upgrade the plate:
scenes.narration: So instead of having just toast or cereal for breakfast, try adding eggs, Greek yogurt, or cottage cheese.

scenes.title: Good until noon.
scenes.narration: You may feel more satisfied and less hungry before lunch.
sources: Leidy et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2013: higher-protein breakfast reduced pre-lunch hunger

scenes.narration: Follow Hello Nutrition AI for more nutrition tips!

sources: Leidy H.J. et al. Beneficial effects of a higher-protein breakfast on the appetitive, hormonal, and neural signals controlling energy intake regulation in overweight/obese, 'breakfast-skipping,' late-adolescent girls. Am J Clin Nutr. 2013;97(4):677-688.
Batterham R.L. et al. Critical role for peptide YY in protein-mediated satiation and body-weight regulation. Cell Metab. 2006;4(3):223-233.
Westerterp-Plantenga M.S. et al. Dietary protein, weight loss, and weight maintenance. Annu Rev Nutr. 2009;29:21-41 (protein is the most satiating macronutrient).
